newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish LOT to set up domestic flights firm.
newsitem.headline: Polish LOT to set up domestic flights firm.

text.p: Poland's state-owned national airline PLL LOT SA will set up a fully-owned subsidiary, called Eurolot, to operate its so far loss-making domestic flights business, Reczpospolita daily reported on Saturday.
It said the new company would start operating in April next year, probably with eight or nine 19-seat Canadian-made Jet-Stream-31 airplanes.
LOT expects to carry 310,000 to 315,000 passengers on domestic flights this year, about 16 percent more than last year, the daily's report said, without identifying its source.
Revenue from domestic flights is expected to rise to 40 million zlotys this year from 28.5 million zlotys in 1995.
Nevertheless, the domestic business is likely to bring a net loss of about 10 million zlotys, down from a 14.5 million loss in 1995.
